status: frozen before reading S02 ground-truth annotations
source: Official AI City Challenge 2022 Track 1 CityFlowV2, current public distribution
license_scope: Local noncommercial research only. No raw frames/videos/labels or dataset-trained model deployed to the public application. Publish aggregate research findings and provenance only.
selection: First official validation scenario by numeric name, S02; all four cameras c006,c007,c008,c009. Chosen from archive directory and frame-count/timestamp metadata, not outcomes.

detector.model: yolo11n.pt, unchanged pretrained ATLAS UA-DETRAC baseline

domain_transfer: No CityFlow training, label tuning or selection. External pretrained COCO weights remain frozen. This is not an official leaderboard submission or the entire CityFlowV2 benchmark.

association.method: Offline zero-shot appearance association using normalized pooled YOLO backbone crop embeddings, up to four evenly spaced crops per candidate track
association.cluster_rule: Greedy descending-similarity links; at most one tracklet from each camera per identity cluster

evaluation.matching: Bounding-box IoU >=0.5; TrackEval Identity with one global identity namespace across concatenated camera/frame slots
evaluation.primary_ablation: Same candidate detections and full frames before/after cross-camera identity association, changing only the ID map
evaluation.secondary: Associated identities observed in at least two cameras, matching the annotation target definition; report filtering coverage separately
evaluation.per_camera: Annotation-scoped single-camera IDF1; unannotated real vehicles may count as false positives, so this is not full visible-vehicle accuracy
evaluation.uncertainty: One complete four-camera scenario; no cross-city statistical claim
evaluation.time: Apply published per-camera start offsets for temporal candidate gating; source skipped/stuck frames limit exact synchronization
evaluation.physical_speed: Not evaluated: manual homographies are not independent surveyed speed ground truth

ngsim_prerequisite: Complete 11,220-frame raw NGSIM recording, actual CV-driven native SUMO and independent error comparison implemented; three playback/mobile/missing-data browser tests pass before expansion
